text: Beautiful app that helps me daily to better manage my ADHD. Download it, I highly recommend it.
author: Igor Emmanuel
developer_reply:
Thank you so much, Igor 🙏

It means a lot to hear Sprout is helping with ADHD management, executive dysfunction, and daily task organisation. That’s exactly why we built features like Brain Dump, AI task breakdown, time estimates, and gentle reminders to reduce overwhelm and decision fatigue.

So grateful you’re part of the Sprout community 🌱
